sloka: निकुम्भो भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवेण निपातितम्।प्रदहन्निव कोपेन वानरेन्द्रमवैक्षत ।। ६.७७.१ ।।
transliteration: nikumbho bhrātaraṁ dṛṣṭvā sugrīveṇa nipātitam।pradahanniva kopena vānarendramavaikṣata ।। 6.77.1 ।।

translations.english: Seeing his brother struck down by Sugriva, Nikumbha gazed at him as if to burn him in wrath.
